title: Read the estimation download fallback
description: You inspect the artifact archive branch and its exception handler.

steps.description: You import archive and path tools, then try to load Colab's files helper. The later archive and download calls share this try block.
You create artifacts.zip and request its download when artifacts exists. Otherwise, the helper prints a missing-folder message.

steps.question: What happens when files.download raises an exception?
steps.answer: The except block prints the helper-unavailable message and the exception text.

steps.description: You see that fallback in the recording. Its exception identifies google.colab.files.download as unavailable in code-viz.
